text.text_excerpt: Wanted to go to the Sazerac Bar but ended up here instead because we're tourists and these things happen. Bartender Roxanne let us know we were in the wrong place but the happy hour was too good to leave. $3 beers via bottle and $4 wells are a pretty good deal. Also Bartender Roxanne made a pretty good Sazerac since there are probably a lot of people who got confused like we did. Not a big place by any means, but a few TVs around and about for games and a great atmosphere overall. Didn't expect much out of this spot, though glad we stopped by. Drinks are strong and the bartender is friendly. Would definitely come back.

Fun fact: this bar is the closest place to grab a plate night beer while I'm waiting for the bus home. And since my boss only comes once an hour, I find myself here quite a bit. The staff are always great. There's not typically a ton of locals there (maybe more folks from the hotel next door who need something easier to drink than a Sazerac?), and its always fun to chat with out of towers about their plans for food and drink in New Orleans. They've also got a great happy hour for those of you who work in the CBD! Typically I'm here later in the evening and stick to some cheap domestic beers, but they're also got a great bloody mary if you're around earlier in the day! (Or if you're into b...

I am only reviewing be bar. And we only had one drink. Lol. But, it was a pretty neat experience. After googling the top drinks in NO,the szaerac was the number one drink. And it said the best place to get one was here. The place was empty when we arrived, but we were warmly greeted upon arrival. The bartender was super kind, personable, and knowledgeable about the area and the drink she was preparing. We had no idea what kind of drink we were going to get, but it was delicious. A slow sipping drink packed with a lot of flavor. By necessarily my kind of drink as a go to, but I enjoyed it and the experience. Would definitely agree that this was the best place to try that drink.
